title: Upward Technologies vs HubSpot
content_html:
Upward Technologies vs HubSpot, Which one is best for your business?
If you need a ready-made CRM, marketing automation and customer-service tools that you can start using immediately, HubSpot is usually the faster, lower-cost choice. If your workflows are highly custom, involve multiple systems that don’t talk to each other, or require on-premise hosting and bespoke AI agents, Upward Technologies’ custom-software approach is generally the better fit.

HubSpot and Upward Technologies both handle customer data and automate team workflows, but they work in opposite ways. HubSpot is a pre-built platform with fixed modules for marketing, sales, customer service, operations, and commerce. Upward Technologies designs and builds custom software that mirrors how your team already works, then hosts and runs it. HubSpot suits teams whose process fits a standard CRM. Upward Technologies suits teams whose workflow is non-standard or whose tools do not talk to each other.

What HubSpot is good at

HubSpot is an AI-powered customer platform with software for marketing, sales, customer service, content management, operations, and commerce, according to its website. It puts all of HubSpot's marketing, sales, and customer service software on one agentic platform. The platform includes pre-built AI agents called AI Teammates that work alongside teams inside workflows.

HubSpot offers free and premium plans across its Hubs, and a free CRM to start. The free CRM is built for small businesses to organize contacts, track deals, and close sales with built-in AI, and requires no credit card. Paid plans scale with your team, and HubSpot Credits are a usage currency shared across the account that resets monthly.

HubSpot integrates with Slack, Google Drive, Zoom and more than 100 apps, according to its website. It also offers a REST API for building integrations. The platform works well for teams that run standard go-to-market, sales, or customer-service workflows and want a single vendor to handle them.

What Upward Technologies does differently

Upward Technologies builds custom software designed around your exact process, not around a standard workflow. It does not sell pre-built modules or packages. Instead, it starts with a three-week paid scoping phase where your team and Upward map your current workflow, the bottlenecks, and what needs to change. That phase ends with a document you could take to another supplier and a clear go-or-no-go decision. Only after that does Upward build.

Upward Technologies then hosts and runs what it builds on your own hardware or on Upward-hosted servers in the Netherlands. Your data does not flow to external AI services. The software is built to fit your team's actual steps, not the other way around.

Upward Technologies also builds integrations so data is entered once and shared across your systems. If you use multiple tools today (an ERP, a CRM, a finance system, separate chat), Upward can connect them so a single entry reaches all of them. That cuts the re-typing that custom software is often meant to solve.

Upward Technologies also builds AI agents for repetitive work. Where HubSpot's AI Teammates work inside HubSpot's own modules, Upward's agents can read and search your own documents and data, and hand off decisions that need a human judgment call back to a person.

Which one should you pick

Pick HubSpot if: you need a CRM, marketing automation, or customer-service software today and your team's workflow fits a standard process. HubSpot's free plan lets you start immediately with no setup, and its paid tiers scale as your team grows. It works well for sales teams running outbound campaigns, customer-success teams managing support tickets, or marketing teams running campaigns across channels.

Pick Upward Technologies if: your team's workflow does not fit a standard package, you need to connect multiple tools so data enters once, or you need custom software that your own IT team does not have time to build. Upward suits teams that lose hours to re-typing data between systems, teams whose process is too specific for off-the-shelf tools, or teams that need AI agents reading your own documents instead of generic templates. You also get hosting and support built in, so you do not manage the software yourself. To explore custom software options, you can learn more about how Upward builds custom software on our website.

Pick both if: you use HubSpot for sales and customer service but need custom software to handle a separate process (like operations, finance, or a specific workflow). Upward can build that software and integrate it with HubSpot so data flows both ways.

If your team's workflow fits HubSpot's standard modules and you want to start fast, HubSpot is the quicker choice. If you need something custom or need to solve a specific problem HubSpot does not cover, a conversation with Upward Technologies can clarify whether custom software is the right fit. The three-week scoping phase is paid, but it ends with a clear answer before any code is written.

FAQ

What is the difference between Upward Technologies and HubSpot?

HubSpot is a ready-made platform with fixed modules for CRM, marketing, sales, and service. Upward Technologies builds custom software designed around your exact workflow. HubSpot is faster to start and suits standard processes. Upward Technologies suits non-standard workflows, multi-system integration, and teams that need hosting and support included.

Can I use HubSpot and Upward Technologies together?

Yes. You can run HubSpot for sales and customer service, and have Upward Technologies build custom software for a separate process (like operations or finance) and integrate it with HubSpot so data flows both ways.

Does Upward Technologies replace HubSpot?

Not always. If your team's workflow fits HubSpot's modules, HubSpot is the faster and cheaper option. Upward Technologies is a better fit if you need custom software, if you need to connect multiple systems, or if your process is too specific for a standard CRM.

How long does it take to set up Upward Technologies compared to HubSpot?

HubSpot can be set up in hours and used immediately. Upward Technologies starts with a three-week paid scoping phase to map your workflow and decide what to build. After that, building the software takes longer, but the result is custom to your process.

Does Upward Technologies offer a CRM like HubSpot does?

Upward Technologies does not sell a pre-built CRM. It builds custom software around your workflow, which may include CRM-like functions if your process needs them. ERIS, Upward's all-in-one business platform, is currently in beta and will include CRM capabilities soon, but it is not available today. If you need a CRM now, HubSpot is the faster choice.

Can Upward Technologies integrate with HubSpot?

Yes. Upward Technologies builds integrations so data flows between systems. If you use HubSpot for sales and need custom software for another process, Upward can connect them so a single entry in one system reaches the other.
